Reference assets

rglimpse2_genetic_maps() rglimpse2_genetic_map()

GLIMPSE2 operations

rglimpse2_chunk()
Create deterministic GLIMPSE2 imputation chunks
rglimpse2_split_reference()
Build one GLIMPSE2 binary reference chunk
rglimpse2_phase()
Phase and impute one GLIMPSE2 chunk from genotype likelihoods
rglimpse2_phase_bam()
Phase and impute one GLIMPSE2 chunk directly from one BAM or CRAM
rglimpse2_phase_bams()
Phase and impute one GLIMPSE2 chunk directly from several BAMs or CRAMs
rglimpse2_ligate()
Ligate ordered GLIMPSE2 chunk outputs
